title: Drake Maye, wife pay $15,000 classroom costs for 54 Providence school educators
summary_full: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye and his wife, Ann Michael, paid for the classroom wish lists of all 54 teachers and support specialists at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence, Rhode Island. The $15,000 donation through their MayeDay Family Foundation came as 98% of the school’s students receive free or reduced-price lunch.
